name: Hatsukoi Signal
source:
Boy x girl, boy x boy, girl x girl――

Upon advanced into second grade of high school, 4 boys and girls met and then various kind of "first love" buds there. 

Do not stop after you started running. That's what "first love" is――
translation:
男孩与女孩，男孩与男孩，女孩与女孩——

升入高中二年级后，四名少男少女相遇，各种各样的“初恋”由此萌芽。

一旦开始奔跑，就不会再停下。这就是“初恋”——
